messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Installing rstanarm
parts:
The error might be still due to that rstan is installed for only one bitness, 64 or 32.  If it is, one way is to install rstan for both 64 and 32 bits by using 

install.packages('rstan', type = 'source', INSTALL_opts = "--merge-multiarch")

The other way is to update your R.  R 3.0.1 on mac only has 64 bits now. 

--
Jiqiang
